```{r, read-input, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PERSIAPAN & SANITASI DATA BASELINE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
descriptive_analysis_file <- "inst/extdata/output/descriptive_analysis_module.rds"
projection_area_file_bau <- "inst/extdata/scenario/scenarioBAU/luc_projection.xlsx"

initial_year <- params$initial_year

baseline <- load_projection_baseline(
  path = descriptive_analysis_file,
  projection_area_file_bau = projection_area_file_bau
)

# Akses komponen baseline
gdp_baseline      <- baseline$gdp_baseline
leontief_matrix   <- baseline$leontief_matrix
full_io_table     <- baseline$full_io_table
code_registry     <- baseline$code_registry
sector_idx        <- baseline$sector_idx
intermediate_consumption.m <- baseline$intermediate_consumption
income_multiplier <- baseline$income_multiplier
labour_multiplier <- baseline$labour_multiplier
SUB_multiplier    <- baseline$SUB_multiplier
output_multiplier <- baseline$output_multiplier
linkage_table     <- baseline$linkage_table
P_default         <- baseline$P_default
growth_rate       <- baseline$growth_rate
area_matrix_bau   <- baseline$area_matrix_bau
constrained       <- baseline$constrained
unconstrained     <- baseline$unconstrained

scenario_inputs <- list(
    name              = paste0("Skenario_", params$scenario_name),
    luc_projection    = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario3/luc_projection.xlsx",
    land_distribution = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario3/luc_projection.xlsx",
    lpc               = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario3/produktivitas_lpc.xlsx",
    io_changes        = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario3/perubahan_io.xlsx"
  )

sc_input <- load_scenario_inputs(scenario_inputs, P_default)

# Ekstraksi Vektor Sektoral Utuh
sektor_names <- as.character(unlist(gdp_baseline$SECTOR))
Y_0 <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$FD)); names(Y_0) <- sektor_names
x_0 <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$OUTPUT)); names(x_0) <- sektor_names
v_0 <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$GDP)); names(v_0) <- sektor_names
Land_0 <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$Land_Requirement))
LPC_0 <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$LPC))

# Matriks Transaksi Antara (Z)
Z <- as.matrix(baseline$intermediate_consumption)
storage.mode(Z) <- "numeric"
rownames(Z) <- colnames(Z) <- sektor_names

# Filtering Sektor Valid (Hanya Sektor dengan Output Baseline > 0)
idx_valid <- which(x_0 > 0)
Z <- Z[idx_valid, idx_valid, drop = FALSE]
x_0 <- x_0[idx_valid]
Y_0 <- Y_0[idx_valid]
v_0 <- v_0[idx_valid]
Land_0 <- Land_0[idx_valid]
LPC_0 <- LPC_0[idx_valid]
sektor_names <- sektor_names[idx_valid]
n <- length(idx_valid)

# EKSTRAKSI KOEFISIEN INPUT PRIMER LANGSUNG (KOREKSI REAL VALUE)
# A. Koefisien PDRB / GDP
v_c <- as.numeric(unlist(gdp_baseline$GDP_PROP))[idx_valid]

# B. Koefisien Pendapatan Tenaga Kerja Langsung (w_c)
w_c <- as.numeric(unlist(baseline$labour_multiplier$Labour_Compensation))[idx_valid] / x_0

# C. Koefisien Serapan Tenaga Kerja Langsung (l_c) -> Satuan: Orang / Juta Rp
l_c <- as.numeric(unlist(baseline$labour_multiplier$Labour))[idx_valid] / x_0

# D. Koefisien Surplus Usaha Bruto Langsung (sub_c)
sub_c <- as.numeric(unlist(baseline$SUB_multiplier$Surplus))[idx_valid] / x_0

# Mapping Indeks Sektor Terkendala (co) dan Bebas (nc)
constrained <- baseline$constrained
unconstrained <- baseline$unconstrained
co_idx <- which(idx_valid %in% which(constrained == 1))
no_idx <- which(idx_valid %in% which(unconstrained == 1))

# Reklasifikasi Sektor Bermasalah (Land_0 = 0 atau LPC_0 = 0 dipindahkan ke nc)
mask_bermasalah <- (Land_0[co_idx] <= 0) | (LPC_0[co_idx] <= 0)
if (any(mask_bermasalah)) {
  co_idx_pindah <- co_idx[mask_bermasalah]
  co_idx <- co_idx[!mask_bermasalah]
  no_idx <- sort(c(no_idx, co_idx_pindah))
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FORMULASI SUB-MATRIKS MIXED INPUT-OUTPUT
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Matriks Koefisien Teknis (A) dan Matriks Leontief (M = I - A)
A_full <- sweep(Z, 2, x_0, "/")
M_full <- diag(n) - A_full

# Partisi Sub-matriks dan Inversi Sektor Non-Lahan
idx_co <- co_idx
idx_nc <- no_idx
p_0_co <- as.numeric(LPC_0[idx_co])
M_nc_co <- M_full[idx_nc, idx_co, drop = FALSE]
M_nc_nc <- M_full[idx_nc, idx_nc, drop = FALSE]
M_nc_nc_inv <- solve(M_nc_nc) # Inversi khusus sub-matriks unconstrained
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# SKRIP LENGKAP SKENARIO HILIRISASI: RESTRUCTURING & RAS MATRIX BALANCING
# Pemodelan: Supply-Constrained Mixed Input-Output (Hubacek & Sun, 2001)
# Balancing: Biproportional Matrix Balancing / RAS (Miller & Blair, 2009)
# ==============================================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FUNGSI ALGORITMA RAS BALANCING
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ras_balance_io <- function(A_0, x_target, u_target, v_target, tol = 1e-6, max_iter = 1000) {
  # A_0      : Matriks Koefisien Teknis Awal (n x n)
  # x_target : Vektor Total Output Target Baru (n x 1)
  # u_target : Vektor Target Total Penjualan Antara Baris / Row Sum Z (n x 1)
  # v_target : Vektor Target Total Pembelian Antara Kolom / Col Sum Z (n x 1)
  
  n <- length(x_target)
  A_k <- A_0
  iter <- 0
  diff <- Inf
  
  while (diff > tol && iter < max_iter) {
    iter <- iter + 1
    
    # 1. Hitung Matriks Transaksi Z_k
    Z_k <- sweep(A_k, 2, x_target, "*")
    
    # 2. Penyesuaian Baris (Row Adjustment Factor - r)
    u_k <- rowSums(Z_k)
    r <- ifelse(u_k == 0, 1, u_target / u_k)
    r[!is.finite(r)] <- 1
    A_k <- sweep(A_k, 1, r, "*")
    
    # 3. Hitung Ulang Z_k setelah Penyesuaian Baris
    Z_k <- sweep(A_k, 2, x_target, "*")
    
    # 4. Penyesuaian Kolom (Column Adjustment Factor - s)
    v_k <- colSums(Z_k)
    s <- ifelse(v_k == 0, 1, v_target / v_k)
    s[!is.finite(s)] <- 1
    A_k <- sweep(A_k, 2, s, "*")
    
    # 5. Evaluasi Konvergensi (Maksimum Selisih Margin)
    Z_k <- sweep(A_k, 2, x_target, "*")
    diff <- max(abs(c(rowSums(Z_k) - u_target, colSums(Z_k) - v_target)), na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Hitung Invers Leontief Baru L = (I - A)^(-1)
  L_k <- solve(diag(n) - A_k)
  
  list(
    A_balanced = A_k,
    Z_balanced = Z_k,
    L_balanced = L_k,
    iterations = iter,
    max_diff = diff
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FUNGSI MEMPROSES INPUT & REKALKULASI SISTEM I-O HASIL RAS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
process_sc_ras_system <- function(df_input, Z_base, Y_base, VA_base, X_base, Labour_base, Wage_base, sektor_names) {
  
  # --- PENGAMAN DIMENSI ---
  Z_base <- as.matrix(Z_base)
  storage.mode(Z_base) <- "numeric"
  if (is.null(dim(Z_base)) || length(dim(Z_base)) != 2) {
    stop("Z_base harus berupa matriks 2 dimensi. Cek struktur input Z.")
  }
  
  n <- length(sektor_names)
  if (nrow(Z_base) != n || ncol(Z_base) != n) {
    stop(sprintf("Dimensi Z_base (%dx%d) tidak cocok dengan jumlah sektor (%d).",
                 nrow(Z_base), ncol(Z_base), n))
  }
  
  # Pastikan X_base, Y_base, VA_base, Labour_base, Wage_base adalah vektor numerik
  X_base      <- as.numeric(unlist(X_base))
  Y_base      <- as.numeric(unlist(Y_base))
  VA_base     <- as.numeric(unlist(VA_base))
  Labour_base <- as.numeric(unlist(Labour_base))
  Wage_base   <- as.numeric(unlist(Wage_base))
  
  if (length(X_base) != n) stop(sprintf("Panjang X_base (%d) != jumlah sektor (%d).", length(X_base), n))
  if (length(Y_base) != n) stop(sprintf("Panjang Y_base (%d) != jumlah sektor (%d).", length(Y_base), n))
  if (length(VA_base) != n) stop(sprintf("Panjang VA_base (%d) != jumlah sektor (%d).", length(VA_base), n))
  
  # --- FILTER INPUT ---
  df_input <- df_input %>%
    filter(!is.na(`SEKTOR ASAL (FROM SECTOR)`), `PENAMBAHAN TRANSAKSI ANTARA / ΔZ (Rp Juta)` > 0)
  
  Z_init <- Z_base
  X_new  <- X_base
  
  # 2. Injeksi Pengalihan pada Z dan Target X
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_input))) {
    from_name <- df_input$`SEKTOR ASAL (FROM SECTOR)`[i]
    to_name <- df_input$`SEKTOR TUJUAN (TO SECTOR)`[i]
    delta_z <- as.numeric(df_input$`PENAMBAHAN TRANSAKSI ANTARA / ΔZ (Rp Juta)`[i])
    delta_x_from <- as.numeric(df_input$`PERUBAHAN OUTPUT ASAL ΔX (Rp Juta)`[i])
    delta_x_to <- as.numeric(df_input$`PERUBAHAN OUTPUT TUJUAN ΔX (Rp Juta)`[i])
    
    idx_from <- which(sektor_names == from_name)
    idx_to <- which(sektor_names == to_name)
    
    if (length(idx_from) > 0 && length(idx_to) > 0) {
      Z_init[idx_from, idx_to] <- Z_init[idx_from, idx_to] + delta_z
      if (!is.na(delta_x_from)) X_new[idx_from] <- X_new[idx_from] + delta_x_from
      if (!is.na(delta_x_to)) X_new[idx_to] <- X_new[idx_to] + delta_x_to
    }
  }
  
  # 3. Hitung Target Margin RAS (u_target & v_target)
  u_target <- rowSums(Z_init)
  v_target <- colSums(Z_init)
  
  # 4. Buat Matriks Koefisien Teknis Awal (A_0)
  X_safe <- ifelse(X_base == 0, 1, X_base)
  A_0 <- sweep(Z_base, 2, X_safe, "/")
  
  # 5. Eksekusi RAS Balancing
  ras_res <- ras_balance_io(
    A_0 = A_0,
    x_target = X_new,
    u_target = u_target,
    v_target = v_target,
    tol = 1e-6,
    max_iter = 1000
  )
  
  # 6. Hitung Residu Final Demand (Y_new) dan Value Added (VA_new)
  Y_new <- X_new - rowSums(ras_res$Z_balanced)
  VA_new <- X_new - colSums(ras_res$Z_balanced)
  
  # 7. Hitung Koefisien Input Primer Baru
  X_safe_new <- ifelse(X_new == 0, 1, X_new)
  v_c_new <- VA_new / X_safe_new
  w_c_new <- Wage_base / X_safe_new
  l_c_new <- Labour_base / X_safe_new
  
  # 8. Hitung Indeks Keterkaitan (Rasmussen Linkages) Baru
  L_new <- ras_res$L_balanced
  sum_L <- sum(L_new)
  back_link <- (n * colSums(L_new)) / sum_L
  forw_link <- (n * rowSums(L_new)) / sum_L
  
  list(
    Z_new = ras_res$Z_balanced,
    A_new = ras_res$A_balanced,
    L_new = L_new,
    X_new = X_new,
    Y_new = Y_new,
    VA_new = VA_new,
    v_c_new = v_c_new,
    w_c_new = w_c_new,
    l_c_new = l_c_new,
    output_multiplier = colSums(L_new),
    backward_linkage = back_link,
    forward_linkage = forw_link,
    ras_iterations = ras_res$iterations,
    ras_diff = ras_res$max_diff,
    input_summary = df_input
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FUNGSI PROYEKSI MIXED I-O MULTI-TAHUN
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
proyeksi_skenario_multi_fd <- function(area_matrix, P_matrix, Y_0, idx_co, idx_nc, 
                                      p_0_co, M_nc_co, M_nc_nc_inv, A_full, v_c, 
                                      w_c, l_c, sub_c, growth_rate, initial_year, tahun) {
  t_max <- length(tahun)
  n <- length(v_c)
  m <- length(idx_co)
  
  x_out <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  PDRB_sektoral <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  Inc_sektoral <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  Lab_sektoral <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  SUB_sektoral <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = n)
  L_co_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = m)
  FD_co_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = t_max, ncol = m)
  
  P_sub <- as.matrix(P_matrix[idx_co, , drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(P_sub) <- "numeric"
  
  for (k in seq_len(t_max)) {
    yr <- tahun[k]
    selisih_tahun <- yr - initial_year
    
    # Final Demand Sektor Non-Lahan
    Y_nc_t <- Y_0[idx_nc] * ((1 + growth_rate[idx_nc]) ^ selisih_tahun)
    
    # Output Sektor Lahan Terkendalikan Tutupan Lahan BAU
    luas_tutupan_t <- as.numeric(unlist(area_matrix[, k]))
    L_co_t <- as.vector(P_sub %*% luas_tutupan_t)
    x_co_t <- matrix(L_co_t * p_0_co, ncol = 1)
    
    # Solusi Simultana Mixed IO
    rhs <- Y_nc_t - (M_nc_co %*% x_co_t)
    x_nc_t <- M_nc_nc_inv %*% rhs
    
    # Output Total
    x_t <- numeric(n)
    x_t[idx_co] <- as.vector(x_co_t)
    x_t[idx_nc] <- as.vector(x_nc_t)
    
    # Net Ekspor Lahan
    konsumsi_antara_co <- as.vector(A_full[idx_co, , drop = FALSE] %*% x_t)
    FD_co_t <- as.vector(x_co_t) - konsumsi_antara_co
    
    # Hitung Indikator Makroekonomi
    PDRB_sektoral[k, ] <- v_c * x_t
    Inc_sektoral[k, ]  <- w_c * x_t
    Lab_sektoral[k, ]  <- l_c * x_t
    SUB_sektoral[k, ]  <- sub_c * x_t
    
    x_out[k, ] <- x_t
    L_co_matrix[k, ] <- L_co_t
    FD_co_matrix[k, ] <- FD_co_t
  }
  
  tibble(
    Tahun = tahun,
    PDRB_Total_Juta = rowSums(PDRB_sektoral, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pendapatan_TK_Juta = rowSums(Inc_sektoral, na.rm = TRUE),
    Serapan_TK_Orang = rowSums(Lab_sektoral, na.rm = TRUE),
    Surplus_Usaha_Bruto_Juta = rowSums(SUB_sektoral, na.rm = TRUE),
    Output_Total_Juta = rowSums(x_out, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EKSEKUSI PEMBENTUKAN SISTEM I-O BARU DENGAN RAS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
labour_nominal <- as.numeric(unlist(baseline$labour_multiplier$Labour))[idx_valid]
wage_nominal   <- as.numeric(unlist(baseline$labour_multiplier$Labour_Compensation))[idx_valid]

sc_io_system <- process_sc_ras_system(
  df_input     = sc_input$io_changes,
  Z_base       = Z,             # matriks 65x65 hasil filter
  Y_base       = Y_0,           # vektor FD hasil filter
  VA_base      = v_0,           # vektor PDRB sektoral hasil filter
  X_base       = x_0,           # vektor output hasil filter
  Labour_base  = labour_nominal,
  Wage_base    = wage_nominal,
  sektor_names = sektor_names
)

cat("==================================================================\n")
cat(sprintf("  Skenario Hilirisasi: RAS Balancing Konvergen pada Iterasi ke-%d\n",
            sc_io_system$ras_iterations))
cat(sprintf("   Maksimum Selisih Margin vs Target: %.10f\n",
            sc_io_system$ras_diff))
cat("==================================================================\n")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EKSEKUSI PROYEKSI MULTI-TAHUN SKENARIO
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Partisi Sub-Matriks Mixed IO Baru dari Matriks A_new Hasil RAS
A_nc_nc_sc <- sc_io_system$A_new[idx_nc, idx_nc]
A_nc_co_sc <- sc_io_system$A_new[idx_nc, idx_co]

M_nc_nc_inv_sc <- solve(diag(length(idx_nc)) - A_nc_nc_sc)
M_nc_co_sc <- -A_nc_co_sc

tahun_proyeksi <- as.numeric(colnames(baseline$area_matrix_bau))

proyeksi_sc_df <- proyeksi_skenario_multi_fd(
  area_matrix = baseline$area_matrix_bau,
  P_matrix = baseline$P_default,   Y_0 = sc_io_system$Y_new,      # Permintaan Akhir Hasil RAS
  idx_co = idx_co,
  idx_nc = idx_nc,
  p_0_co = p_0_co,
  M_nc_co = M_nc_co_sc,           # Sub-matriks Mixed IO Baru
  M_nc_nc_inv = M_nc_nc_inv_sc,  # Sub-Invers Baru
  A_full = sc_io_system$A_new,   # Matriks A Baru
  v_c = sc_io_system$v_c_new,    # Koefisien PDRB Baru
  w_c = sc_io_system$w_c_new,    # Koefisien Gaji Baru
  l_c = sc_io_system$l_c_new,    # Koefisien TK Baru
  sub_c = sub_c,
  growth_rate = growth_rate,
  initial_year = 2025,
  tahun = tahun_proyeksi
)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CETAK HASIL REKAPITULASI & PERBANDINGAN BACKWARD LINKAGE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Tampilkan Rekapitutasi Makroekonomi
print(as.data.frame(proyeksi_sc_df))

# 2. Tampilkan Perbandingan Daya Tarik (Backward Linkage) Sektor Hilirisasi
L_base <- as.matrix(baseline$leontief_matrix)
storage.mode(L_base) <- "numeric"

# Filter ke sektor valid
L_base <- L_base[idx_valid, idx_valid, drop = FALSE]

n_base <- nrow(L_base)
sum_L_base <- sum(L_base)

bl_baseline <- (n_base * colSums(L_base)) / sum_L_base

df_linkage_compare <- data.frame(
  Sektor = sektor_names,
  Backward_Linkage_Baseline = as.numeric(bl_baseline),
  Backward_Linkage_sc_RAS   = sc_io_system$backward_linkage,
  Output_Multiplier_sc_RAS  = sc_io_system$output_multiplier
) %>%
  filter(Sektor %in% c(
    "Padi", "Penggilingan Padi", "Jagung",
    "Jasa Tempat Makan / Restoran",
    "Karet dan tanaman tahunan lainnya", "Pengolahan Karet"
  ))

cat("\n--- PERBANDINGAN DAYA TARIK (BACKWARD LINKAGE) SEBELUM VS SESUDAH HILIRISASI ---\n")
print(df_linkage_compare)
```
